text:
Ava: OK urgent update: Ollie has claimed the new bathroom tile as his throne. pic: https://img.internal/ollie-dragon-tile.jpg :crown: 
Sam: omg that pattern makes him look like a tiny dragon. :dragon_face: 
Diego: tile flex. where did you get it? it really accents the whiskers. 
Ava: got it from a local salvage shop during the remodel, 2-for-1 on mythical vibes. 
Priya: that half-snooze, half-alert ear posture is peak loaf. :heart_eyes: 
Sam: vote: should we put a tiny engraved plaque that says "Ollie, Protector of Tiles"? :laughing: 
Diego: yes. also request for more pics. close-up of the dragon-eye pattern? 
Ava: posted a close-up in thread: https://img.internal/ollie-zoom.jpg — you can see his paw perfectly matching a scale. 
Priya: craftsmanship and cat coordination 10/10. 
ops-bot: Reminder: Office pets are allowed in common areas only on alternating Fridays. :calendar: 
Ava: noted — this is technically at home but shhh. 
Sam: also tagging @Diego for tile envy. :eyes: 
Diego: tagging accepted. will commence tile acquisition mission. 
Priya: also low-key wondering if Ollie would make a good mascot for 'Dragon Tiles Inc.' 
Ava: he already does merch in his head. 
Sam: link to dramatic slo-mo stretch plz? I demand a GIF. 
Ava: GIF: https://img.internal/ollie-stretch.gif — comes with dramatic chipmunk soundtrack. 
Priya: perfect. saving for morale. 
Diego: placing this in my 'things that make me happy on engineering call days' folder. 
Sam: reaction: :heart: (to Ava's first pic) 
Ava: thanks friends. Ollie sends a single sleepy blink in return. 
Pria: request: next watercooler theme: office pets with interior design aspirations. whos in? :raised_hands: 
Sam: in. 
Diego: in. 
ops-bot: Poll created: "Bring a pet + design prop to show-and-tell next Friday?" Options: Yes / No / Only virtual. 
Ava: voted Yes. 
Priya: voted Yes. 
Sam: voted Only virtual (my apartment is chaos). 
Diego: voted Yes. 
Ava: last laugh: Ollie attempted to sit on the pattern thinking it was a warm dragon; then demanded snacks. classic."
